scope: Postmortem of the 32-image baseline and seven-image vision pilot; blind-review experiment is a separate frozen development run.

findings.what: Audiveris rejected 31/32 original crops; logs report staff spacing of roughly 6–10 pixels as too low. Enlarging and padding allowed all 32 to emit output.
findings.why: Its scale-estimation assumptions reject small staff geometry before recognition. This is an input compatibility failure, not evidence that the song is unreadable.
findings.next_test: Separate enlargement from padding on fixed inputs if continuing with Audiveris.

findings.what: None of seven enlarged Audiveris outputs contained a whole OCR word matching the chord grammar. Five had no OCR words; two had garbled text. The adapter promoted zero chords.
findings.why: An adapter cannot recover chord text that the upstream recognizer never emitted. The earlier hypothesis failed at its prerequisite.
findings.next_test: Use a recognizer trained for lead-sheet harmony or read chord image regions directly.

findings.status: observed error; internal model cause unproven
findings.what: In 내입술로_1 the candidate changes an F4 eighth note to G4. In 내입술의_1 it changes the second of two C4 sixteenth notes to D4.
findings.why: These are one-step staff-position errors in small raster images. Pattern completion or limited spatial discrimination are hypotheses, not established internal causes. The first candidate reported no uncertainty.
findings.next_test: Blind review across every pilot case; subsequently compare higher-resolution/cropped inputs while holding prompt/model fixed.

findings.what: In 내입술의_1 an E4–D4 slur becomes a D4–D4 tie; the next half note is merged with the preceding sixteenth note.
findings.why: The curve was assigned the wrong endpoints and meaning. A syntactically valid tie then changes playback and the normalized event count. Four edit-distance operations across the pilot arise from three local recognition mistakes, not necessarily four independent causes.
findings.next_test: Check visible curve endpoints independently; do not repair based on musical plausibility alone.

findings.what: The G/B label in 내입술의_1 is correct but placed at elapsed beat 5/2 instead of 7/2: one quarter-note beat early.
findings.why: The old chord metric discarded onset time. Matching all 38 labels did not establish correct chord placement.
findings.next_test: Add label-plus-onset scoring; mark null-melody chord rows unscorable rather than guess their times.

findings.what: The checker treated octave-free chord labels as octave-specific pitches. B to C# looked like minus ten semitones.
findings.why: Chord roots and bass labels need pitch-class arithmetic modulo 12, while melody notes need absolute-pitch checks.
findings.next_test: Keep independent hand-calculated boundary tests and preserve old evaluator versions.

findings.status: coverage failure confirmed; domain-shift explanation is a hypothesis
findings.what: Transcoda emitted no harmony spine and sometimes repeated invented note sequences; four outputs reached the generation limit.
findings.why: The tested output path does not cover the required chord symbols. Its full-page synthetic-training regime differs from short church lead-sheet crops; this may contribute to repetition, but has not been isolated causally. A publisher-sample control worked.
findings.next_test: Test a lead-sheet model with chord-capable tokenization before considering more orchestration.

answer_separation.previous_state: Recognition prompts did not include reference text. The controller received development scores to choose later experiments. This was not a held-out evaluation and the CLI read-only sandbox did not make reference files unreadable at OS level.
new_controls: Explicit role goals and allowlisted model-input fields
Fresh tool-disabled reviewer context with only image and candidate
Temporary working directory outside the project
Every case reviewed, without revealing which cases failed
Whole batch sealed before the separate scorer opens labels
Hashes checked before scoring; no reviewer calls after sealing
No score-directed selection or retries inside this run
limits: Blindness prevents one leakage route; it does not guarantee correct analysis.
All 32 supplied excerpts were already used in development; none can be rebranded as untouched test data.
Fresh test songs and independent musician adjudication are needed for generalization and label quality.
For tool-using agents, use a separate container/service with no reference mount and separate credentials; current CLI isolation is application-level, not a hostile-process security boundary.
